description: FrontMCP's skills catalog (@frontmcp/skills): instructions for building with FrontMCP, from setting up a project to production readiness. Without `name`, lists the skills. With `name`, returns its SKILL.md and the reference files beside it; with `file` too, that file.

file.description: One of the skill's reference files, as listed, like "references/create-tool.md".

name: get_skill
title: Read a FrontMCP skill
